Pak-occupied Kashmir Resident Repatriated After Crossing Border

A resident from Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) has been repatriated to Pakistan via the Kaman Post in Uri. The individual had inadvertently crossed into Indian territory. This event marks a repatriation following a border crossing.
